public_rationale: In a post published on 2025-08-03, Marcus wrote that with AI agents there are 'in the end trillions of dollars to be made.' Only this forecast is graded. His statement that agents are worth researching is a judgment and is not scored. 'In the end' sets no deadline. The evidence packet has no admitted item showing realized revenue or economic value from AI agents of about $2 trillion or more. It also has no event showing that AI agents as a category have been abandoned. Because there is no deadline, falling short so far does not count against the forecast. The forecast remains open.
limitations: No outcome evidence was admitted. The primary Gartner releases returned HTTP 403 and could not be read. The other sources were secondary blogs and were not used.
The figures that turned up in search were forecast spending or market-size projections, not realized value. They could not test the claim even if they had been readable.
The evidence does not set out an agreed way to measure the revenue or economic value that comes from AI agents.
'AI agents' and 'trillions of dollars to be made' are loosely defined, so any future measurement will depend on how those terms are defined.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: There is reason to research AI agents, and in the end there are trillions of dollars to be made from them.

statement.excerpt: There is reason to research them, and in the end trillions of dollars to be made.
statement.document_title: AI Agents have, so far, mostly been a dud

from_speaker: There is reason to research them
trillions of dollars to be made
our_interpretation: Read as a forecast that AI agents will eventually produce economic value or revenue in the trillions of US dollars. 'Trillions' means at least $2 trillion, cumulative or annual, from agents specifically. General AI spending or infrastructure spending does not count.
'There is reason to research them' is a normative judgment and is not scored. Only the 'trillions of dollars to be made' part is graded.
'In the end' sets no deadline, so the forecast is open-ended.
In the post Marcus says LLMs will not provide the substrate. So the forecast is about agents of any architecture, not LLM agents in particular.
criteria.support_condition: Credible measurement, such as company filings, official statistics, or independent economic measurement, showing that AI agents have generated revenue or economic value of at least about $2 trillion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: With no deadline, nothing can fully contradict it. Only a decisive event showing that AI agents as a category had been abandoned with no prospect of value could do so, and no such event is plausible on current evidence.
